configuration:
ozone.metadata.dirs /mnt/ozone
ozone.scm.block.client.address ozone-scm-0.ozone-scm
ozone.scm.client.address ozone-scm-0.ozone-scm
ozone.scm.names ozone-scm-0.ozone-scm
ozone.scm.db.dirs /mnt/ozone/scm/db
ozone.scm.ha.ratis.storage.dir /mnt/ozone/scm/ha/ratis/storage
ozone.scm.ha.ratis.snapshot.dir /mnt/ozone/scm/ha/ratis/snapshot
ozone.om.address ozone-om-0.ozone-om:9862
ozone.om.db.dirs /mnt/ozone/om/db
ozone.om.snapshot.diff.db.dir /mnt/ozone/scm/diff
ozone.om.ratis.storage.dir /mnt/ozone/om/ratis/storage
ozone.om.ratis.snapshot.dir /mnt/ozone/om/ratis/snapshot
ozone.scm.datanode.id.dir /mnt/ozone/datanode/id
dfs.container.ratis.datanode.storage.dir /mnt/ozone/datanode/ratis
ozone.recon.address ozone-recon-0.ozone-recon:9891
ozone.recon.db.dir /mnt/ozone/recon/db
ozone.recon.scm.db.dirs /mnt/ozone/recon/scm/db
ozone.recon.om.db.dir /mnt/ozone/recon/om/db
ozone.http.basedir /mnt/ozone/http
hadoop.http.authentication.signature.secret.file /etc/secrets/ozone/ozone-http-auth-signature.secret
{{- if eq (index .Values "ozone_security_enabled") "true" }}
ozone.security.enabled true
hadoop.security.authentication kerberos
hdds.scm.kerberos.principal scm/ozone-scm-0.ozone-scm.zookage.svc.cluster.local@ZOOKAGE.LOCAL
hdds.scm.kerberos.keytab.file /etc/secrets/ozone/ozone.keytab
ozone.om.kerberos.principal ozone/ozone-om-0.ozone-om.zookage.svc.cluster.local@ZOOKAGE.LOCAL
ozone.om.kerberos.keytab.file /etc/secrets/ozone/ozone.keytab
hdds.datanode.kerberos.principal dn/_HOST@ZOOKAGE.LOCAL
hdds.datanode.kerberos.keytab.file /etc/secrets/ozone/ozone.keytab
ozone.recon.kerberos.principal recon/ozone-recon-0.ozone-recon.zookage.svc.cluster.local@ZOOKAGE.LOCAL
ozone.recon.kerberos.keytab.file /etc/secrets/ozone/ozone.keytab
ozone.s3g.kerberos.principal s3g/ozone-s3g.zookage.svc.cluster.local@ZOOKAGE.LOCAL
ozone.s3g.kerberos.keytab.file /etc/secrets/ozone/ozone.keytab
ozone.security.http.kerberos.enabled true
ozone.http.filter.initializers org.apache.hadoop.security.AuthenticationFilterInitializer
hdds.scm.http.auth.type kerberos
hdds.scm.http.auth.kerberos.principal HTTP/ozone-scm-0.ozone-scm.zookage.svc.cluster.local@ZOOKAGE.LOCAL
hdds.scm.http.auth.kerberos.keytab /etc/secrets/ozone/ozone.keytab
ozone.om.http.auth.type kerberos
ozone.om.http.auth.kerberos.principal HTTP/ozone-om-0.ozone-om.zookage.svc.cluster.local@ZOOKAGE.LOCAL
ozone.om.http.auth.kerberos.keytab /etc/secrets/ozone/ozone.keytab
hdds.datanode.http.auth.type kerberos
hdds.datanode.http.auth.kerberos.principal HTTP/_HOST@ZOOKAGE.LOCAL
hdds.datanode.http.auth.kerberos.keytab /etc/secrets/ozone/ozone.keytab
ozone.recon.http.auth.type kerberos
ozone.recon.http.auth.kerberos.principal HTTP/ozone-recon-0.ozone-recon.zookage.svc.cluster.local@ZOOKAGE.LOCAL
ozone.recon.http.auth.kerberos.keytab /etc/secrets/ozone/ozone.keytab
ozone.s3g.http.auth.type kerberos
ozone.s3g.http.auth.kerberos.principal HTTP/ozone-s3g.zookage.svc.cluster.local@ZOOKAGE.LOCAL
ozone.s3g.http.auth.kerberos.keytab /etc/secrets/ozone/ozone.keytab
{{- end }}
ozone.acl.enabled true
ozone.acl.authorizer.class {{ or (index .Values "ozone_acl_authorizer_class") "org.apache.hadoop.ozone.security.acl.OzoneAccessAuthorizer" | html }}
ozone.administrators ozone
ozone.s3.administrators ozone
